verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official CLI (ldcli) and API access tokens for non-interactive authentication. It also claims CI/CD pipeline integrations and webhooks, so it can be driven headlessly from automation, and the self-hosted Relay Proxy runs on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of running the CLI non-interactively in CI (the pack has only titles and claims), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
